findings.description: Populated pool imposes cell widths without reducing configured columns. Rightmost slots are clipped by object containment. On narrow s5/s6, KV(a0) is entirely hidden despite the cache metric and causal result announcing its retention.

Plot legends occupy separate normal-flow space; axis labels, marker descriptions, and status no longer collide. Demonstrated mode and candidate/reference series have distinguishable dashed/dotted styles and legend swatches.
Curation dispositions adapt to wide cells, retaining full phrases with no fragmented vertical strips.

Generic Update chips can wrap to narrow vertical strips during reveal/write motion. Committed originals and endpoint values remain readable; these transient chips do not carry essential causal meaning.

motion_sampling.timing_limit: Browser screenshot operation takes wall-clock time; each motion record gives before/after capture time and pre-capture committed/moving metadata. A later sample may straddle completion. The first in-flight sample and final committed sample establish retained-original/commit behavior.
